mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.member_id, m.nickname, p.title, p.content, p.created_at, p.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_like pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.id) AS like_count FROM post p JOIN member m ON m.id = p.member_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
